headline: H1 FY27 consolidated PAT grew 28% to ₹ 12,447 crore and AUM rose 26% to ₹ 5,84,624 crore
materiality_reason: Major half-yearly financial results demonstrating strong profit and AUM growth, highly relevant for investors.
why: H1 FY27 PAT rose 28% YoY to ₹ 12,447 crore (~14% of FY revenue), beating expectations on strong loan and AUM growth.
